data.summary: The plan tackles the weak Unit 3 early, cycles through all units, and ends with a mixed review week. Each week uses the 15‑hour limit, concrete tasks, and the single live class available in week 2.

weeks.focus: Start with Unit 3 fundamentals and reinforce kinematics basics.
tasks: Read textbook sections on translational kinetic energy and 1‑D kinematics.
Solve 10 problems on kinetic energy calculations and 1‑D motion.
Create a 5‑minute video explaining the relationship between kinetic energy and velocity.
Do 5 free‑response practice questions on work and mark them with the scoring guide.

weeks.focus: Deepen understanding of work and energy with the live class.
tasks: Attend live class 10500 covering work and conservation of energy.
Take detailed notes and summarize key equations in a study notebook.
Complete the post‑class worksheet: 8 problems on work and energy conservation.
Review class recordings and create flashcards for the main concepts.

weeks.focus: Cover momentum and rotational dynamics, linking to earlier units.
tasks: Read chapters on linear momentum and elastic collisions.
Solve 12 problems on impulse and momentum conservation.
Watch a 10‑minute tutorial on torque and solve 5 torque problems.
Write a short reflection on how momentum concepts connect to energy.

weeks.focus: Introduce oscillations and fluids, reinforcing problem‑solving skills.
tasks: Read sections on simple harmonic motion and fluid pressure.
Do 10 practice problems on SHM equations and 5 on fluid pressure.
Create a concept map linking SHM, energy, and fluid dynamics.
Simulate a pendulum motion using a free‑response calculator and analyze results.

weeks.focus: Mixed review and timed practice before the exam.
tasks: Take a 60‑minute timed practice test covering all units.
Review incorrect answers and update a master error log.
Do a 30‑minute review session on power, impulse, and angular momentum.
Summarize key formulas on a single cheat sheet for quick reference.

data.final_week_advice: Use the last week for comprehensive review, timed practice, and addressing any remaining weak spots. Focus on application and exam‑style questions to build confidence.
